# Keys and Lending Blog

> Home buying tips for Emerald Coast buyers (Escambia, Santa Rosa and Okaloosa counties, including Eglin AFB and Hurlburt Field): local buyer guides, Pensacola Beach leaseholds, and how a realtor and lender team makes closing smoother.

This blog is published by Keys and Lending, a collaboration between Angee Kent, REALTOR®, LPT Realty, and Jay Spurlin with Coastal Funding Corporation. Articles are informational and are not a commitment to lend; rates and programs are subject to change.

## Business

- Lender/broker: Coastal Funding Corporation, NMLS 103035 · Jay Spurlin, Mortgage Loan Originator, NMLS 183681
- Local service area: the Emerald Coast: Escambia, Santa Rosa and Okaloosa counties (Pensacola, Gulf Breeze, Navarre, Fort Walton Beach, Destin, Crestview, Eglin AFB, Hurlburt Field)
- Coverage: primary-residence purchase and refinance loans in Florida, South Carolina and Tennessee; DSCR investment-property loans nationwide
- Email: info@cfcmtg.com
- Mailing address: 534 S. Navy Blvd, Pensacola, FL 32507
- Main website: https://www.keysandlending.com/
- Equal Housing Opportunity
